utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo. Could you bring the toolbox and help sort the donations when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring the toolbox and help sort the donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and what kind of repairs we’re expecting first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the timing and what repairs are actually needed first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once we’ve got the schedule and a clear list of repairs, so I’m not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, just whatever you’ve got handy — tools, tape, maybe some spare screws. I’m a bit scattered, but I’ll sort the rest when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll let you know if I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what do you need help with on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — I could use a hand sorting tools and checking what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll start sorting the tools and make a quick list of anything still broken.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—let’s keep it simple. If you tell me the time and what needs doing, I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send you the time and a short list of tasks as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn. I’ll be ready when you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are you still available to help with the repair drive, or should I check with someone else?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still available — happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you take the tools table, or would you rather help with check-in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Jules — I’ll keep a careful list of who’s interested and where they’re helping.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Opal — send me the list and I’ll check in with folks and pass along any updates. We’ll make sure everyone knows where they can help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara — could you start by making a quick list of the urgent repairs and who needs each one? Then I’ll sort the priorities and we can match helpers to them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll make a quick list of the urgent repairs and who needs each one, then bring it back to you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we still need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s running low.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’m pretty sure we’re low on tape and a couple of boxes. I’ll check and let you know if I spot anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll note tape and boxes for now—send me anything else you find.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—people are already dropping off tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I can stop by and see if they need any extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great—I'm sure they could use the help, especially with the bigger stuff coming in later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts at 3:30 this afternoon, and please bring the broken item plus any parts or notes you have.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — 3:30 this afternoon, and I’ll bring the broken item with any parts and notes I have.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you bring a flathead screwdriver and some zip ties? That should cover the basics.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s thoughtful of you — I’m sure they’ll appreciate the help. Let me know if you hear anything useful!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll swing by later and let you know what I find out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, but I need to keep things low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — low-key is fine. I might miss a detail or two, but I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you need me to. What part of the repair drive are you working on?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — I’m sorting the tool table and can use a hand with the bigger repairs if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the bigger repairs. Point me to the first one and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure Opal has a clear list of what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — please keep me posted on the list and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll send you the list and drop-off spot as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but we should keep track of who’s bringing what and when it needs to be dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start a quick list and send it around so everyone can sign up for what they’re bringing and when to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the details — what’s happening with it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm — is the repair drive actually happening today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not fully sure yet — let me check the details before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — so it’s not confirmed yet, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Dane—let’s keep it simple and make a clear plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’m in, even if I’m a little late to the planning. Just tell me where you need me, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—please handle the sign-up list and I’ll organize the pickup route. Let’s check in tomorrow afternoon so we can confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up, but I’m still piecing together the details. Do you know what they need us to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m not sure yet, but I can check what’s on the list and let you know. Usually they’re looking for basic tools, batteries, and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help a lot—I’m mostly hearing bits and pieces myself. If you find the list, just pass it along and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m in, I just need a quick reminder on where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — you can drop items off at the community center on Maple, near the side entrance. I’ll be there to sort things if you want a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — Maple by the side entrance, got it. I’ll swing by and bring a few things over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help around the school schedule, but I’ll need to know when the repair drive is happening. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m thinking Saturday morning, around 9 o’clock. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that should work for me. I can plan around Saturday at 9.
